entities.name: T3324 value
entities.description: Information element representing the active time value for MICO mode operation.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function responsible for including the T3324 value IE under specific conditions.

entities.name: UE requested active time value
entities.description: Condition where the UE has requested active time value in the REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: AMF accepts MICO mode and active time
entities.description: Condition where the AMF decides to accept both MICO mode and the use of active time.

entities.name: MICO mode
entities.description: Mobile Initiated Connection Only mode allowing UE to remain in power saving state.

relations.description: AMF includes the T3324 value IE when specified conditions are met.
Inclusion of T3324 value IE is guarded by AMF acceptance of MICO mode and active time.
Inclusion of T3324 value IE is guarded by UE requesting active time value.
AMF acceptance establishes the use of MICO mode.
